The paper-reported constant-D and surface-concentration values are bounded phenomenological anchors rather than a complete qualified TCAD parameter family.
Exact primary mesh and time-step values are engineering choices for the registered domain implementation, subject to independent review and the paired convergence gate.

next_actions: Run the deterministic CSV availability and mask audit before any domain implementation or solver execution.
Materialize the exact eight-case SProcess contract and obtain fresh independent domain review and initialization for this experiment key.
After execution, apply the registered grouped finite-difference uncertainty reduction and the preregistered adequacy and decision gates without changing masks or thresholds.
scheduler_signal.summary: A bounded redesign replaces the structurally unavailable threshold-crossing endpoint with two quantities computed only on existing rows: joint log-profile error for the constant-boundary counterfactual and summed contiguous low-concentration support length for evidence sensitivity. The exact CSV field mappings, masks, uncertainty reduction, numerical gates, and adequacy disposition are preregistered. The study retains the reviewed surface-boundary and tail-support hypotheses and eight one-dimensional executions, but permits no microscopic mechanism claim. Feasibility remains conditional because the bound context names SProcess R-2020.09 but declares no capability statements or limitations; the differently keyed initialized project is not qualification for this intent.

payload.priority_rationale: This single proposal is first because it repairs the reviewed noncomputable endpoint using the supplied rows before spending solver work, then reuses one finite 2 x 2 material-by-boundary factorial for both selected hypotheses. The exact reference tables contain 373 InAlAs and 702 InGaAs direct-pixel rows above 3 x 10^15 cm^-3, so the replacement profile loss is available without crossing or filling a gap. The same outputs support shared-occlusion and sub-limit sensitivities. Continuous-response and two-regime comparisons remain later work because the present evidence has not yet shown that the constant-boundary base family is adequate or that the low-concentration contrast is stable to support masks.

In0.83Al0.17As boundary intervention changing only Cs to 8.35 x 10^19 cm^-3.

In0.83Ga0.17As boundary intervention changing only Cs to 6.85 x 10^19 cm^-3.

current_objectives: Determine whether the two paper-reported material-specific constant surface anchors reduce joint supported-row log-profile error by at least 50% relative to the better common-anchor control while the material-specific constant-D anchor, thermal history, equation, initial condition, and reduction are frozen.

Determine whether the resolved low-concentration support length and the boundary decision change materially when shared-occlusion rows and rows at or below 3 x 10^15 cm^-3 are admitted by exact preregistered masks.
frozen_invariants: Use only the two supplied legend-bound CSV series. Preserve panel_key, series_key, point_index, x_value, y_value, x_uncertainty, y_uncertainty, observed, quantitative_measurement_claim_eligible, below_sims_detection_limit, support_kind, pixel coordinates, coordinate_ownership, shared_group, and support_source_series exactly; never fill a missing point index or treat a shared-occlusion row as independent.

The pre-execution audit must reproduce the exact headers and categorical values. The supplied tables contain 501 In0.83Al0.17As rows and 765 In0.83Ga0.17As rows; support_kind is direct_pixel or shared_occlusion; all observed and eligibility values are 1; all supplied below_sims_detection_limit flags are 0 despite 104 and 10 respective central y_value values at or below 3 x 10^15 cm^-3.

Freeze three masks from actual fields. M0 selects observed=1, quantitative_measurement_claim_eligible=1, support_kind=direct_pixel, and y_value>3 x 10^15 cm^-3, yielding exactly 373 InAlAs and 702 InGaAs rows. M1 uses the same predicates except support_kind may be direct_pixel or shared_occlusion, yielding exactly 397 and 755 rows. M2 selects all observed eligible rows of either support_kind, yielding exactly 501 and 765 rows; it is sensitivity evidence only because numeric central values conflict with the all-zero limit flags.

For M0 every selected row has unit weight. For M1 and M2 define dependence_group as nonblank shared_group; otherwise use the exact tuple panel_key, pixel_x_raw, pixel_y_raw. Give every row in group g weight 1/n_g across both series so a shared source pixel contributes total weight one. No missing or blank provenance field may be guessed.

Temperature is exactly 480 degrees C and elapsed time is exactly 480 s. For material m solve partial C_m/partial t = D_m partial squared C_m/partial x squared on 0<x<L with C_m(x,0)=0, C_m(0,t)=Cs, and C_m(L,t)=0. Use D_Al=1.59 x 10^-12 cm^2/s and D_Ga=1.05 x 10^-12 cm^2/s only as paper-reported anchors.

Set L=x_max+6 sqrt(D_max t), with x_max the deepest existing target x_value, D_max=1.59 x 10^-12 cm^2/s, and t=480 s. The only physical intervention is Cs at 6.85 x 10^19 or 8.35 x 10^19 cm^-3. Do not fit D or Cs, add a source history, add a transport channel, or identify a defect species.

Sample predicted C only at each existing x_value. For row i, y_i=log10(y_value_i/(cm^-3)); u_y,i is max(log10((y_value_i+y_uncertainty_i)/y_value_i), log10(y_value_i/(y_value_i-y_uncertainty_i))) and is unavailable if y_value_i<=y_uncertainty_i. Compute u_x,i as half the absolute difference between predicted log10 C at x_value_i+x_uncertainty_i and x_value_i-x_uncertainty_i, clipped only to the declared domain. Compute u_num,i as the absolute primary-versus-tightened log prediction at the same x_value. Set u_i=sqrt(u_y,i squared+u_x,i squared+u_num,i squared).

For material m, boundary anchor a, and mask k compute WRMSE_m,a,k=sqrt(sum(w_i*(log10(Cpred_m,a(x_i))-y_i)^2)/sum(w_i)) using only finite positive predictions and selected rows. Define J_own,k=sqrt((WRMSE_Al,low,k squared+WRMSE_Ga,high,k squared)/2), J_low,k from both low-anchor cells, J_high,k from both high-anchor cells, and G_k=1-J_own,k/min(J_low,k,J_high,k). G is unavailable if any component is unavailable or the common-anchor denominator is nonpositive.

Define resolved low-concentration support length T_m,k without a threshold crossing: sort selected rows by point_index and sum x_value_i-x_value_previous only when the indices differ by exactly one and both central concentrations are below 5.4 x 10^16 cm^-3; for M0 and M1 both must also exceed 3 x 10^15 cm^-3, while M2 has no lower concentration cutoff. Never add length across a missing index. Report T separately by material and mask.

Propagate uncertainty without random fitting. For each dependence_group, coherently recompute every affected metric under the four combinations of y_i plus or minus u_y,i and x_i plus or minus x_uncertainty_i for all rows in that group; take half the maximum-minus-minimum metric change as that group's finite-difference sensitivity. Add group sensitivities in quadrature, preserving a shared group jointly across materials. Add each case's coherent primary-versus-tightened metric change once as an independent numerical sensitivity. Use estimate plus or minus 1.96 times the resulting standard uncertainty as the reported 95% interval.

The supplied rows at the 5.4 x 10^16 cm^-3 crossing remain structurally discontinuous between point_index 447 and 466 for InAlAs and 363 and 382 for InGaAs. No current quantity depends on interpolating those crossings. The old F, E, qualified-dose, Delta, and R definitions are explicitly deferred and are not execution prerequisites.

No disposition from this study establishes kick-out, VCD, a continuous microscopic response, or any other defect mechanism. Claims are restricted to adequacy and relative performance of the frozen constant-D, constant-boundary family and to robustness of the pixel-derived low-concentration support.

ambiguity_conditions: The 95% interval for G_0 does not separate the 0.25 or 0.50 gate.

The category changes under tightened numerics or an evidence mask.
identifiability_claims.decision_rule: Use the 0.50 support and 0.25 rejection gates only when M0 is available, all four primary/tight pairs pass convergence, both own-anchor models pass 0.15-decade adequacy, and grouped uncertainty is finite.
identifiability_claims.distinguishing_outcome: A stable lower95(G_0)>=0.50 after adequacy and convergence gates supports a dominant role for the two constant boundary anchors within this model; strong mask dependence identifies evidence support as decision-limiting.
identifiability_claims.observable: WRMSE_m,a,k, J_own,k, J_low,k, J_high,k, G_k, grouped uncertainty contributions, and untruncated 95% intervals for M0-M2.
identifiability_claims.smallest_resolving_control: For numerical ambiguity, rerun the exact failed pair at a reviewed tighter level without changing physics; for evidence ambiguity, obtain qualified author raw SIMS rows with detection status and uncertainty.

ambiguity_conditions: A required T is zero or unavailable, so its relative change is undefined.
Any exact field or category needed by a mask is absent.
Grouped uncertainty crosses a decision gate.
identifiability_claims.decision_rule: Apply fixed 50% support, 10% rejection, and intermediate inconclusive regions to each exact mask comparison; shared and sub-limit variants may limit a claim but cannot create a microscopic mechanism preference.
identifiability_claims.distinguishing_outcome: A >=50% change in either resolved support length or a boundary-category change makes evidence support decision-limiting; <=10% changes with stable finite intervals reject the bounded artifact concern.
identifiability_claims.observable: Resolved low-concentration support lengths T_Al,k and T_Ga,k, their per-mask row and adjacency ledgers, propagated intervals, and relative changes from M0.
identifiability_claims.smallest_resolving_control: Obtain author raw SIMS rows for the same samples with reconciled detection-limit status, independent uncertainties, and unambiguous series identity.

objectives: Use the supplied paper evidence to support later selection of falsifiable hypotheses and design of a minimal TCAD control experiment, while this Intake is limited to evidence extraction and does not select a hypothesis.

Determine whether the two paper-reported material-specific constant surface anchors reduce joint supported-row log-profile error by at least 50% relative to the better common-anchor control while the material-specific constant-D anchor, thermal history, equation, initial condition, and reduction are frozen.

Determine whether the resolved low-concentration support length and the boundary decision change materially when shared-occlusion rows and rows at or below 3 x 10^15 cm^-3 are admitted by exact preregistered masks.

If constant-boundary control is rejected or remains ambiguous, the base family is adequate, and the direct-pixel above-limit low-concentration contrast is stable, later compare the reviewed continuous material response with the reviewed two-regime kick-out/VCD phenomenology using a separately reviewed finite model family.

prediction_tests.expected_result: Support the bounded surface-boundary hypothesis only if lower95(G_0)>=0.50, both own-anchor WRMSE values are <=0.15 decade, and the result is unchanged under tightened numerics.
prediction_tests.falsifying_result: Reject the bounded hypothesis only if upper95(G_0)<=0.25 after the same gates pass. If 0.25 and 0.50 are not separated, or either own-anchor WRMSE exceeds 0.15 decade, report inconclusive; inadequacy is not rejection evidence.
prediction_tests.observable: M0 joint log-profile gain G_0 for the material-specific own-anchor pair relative to the better common-anchor control, after numerical and own-anchor adequacy gates.

prediction_tests.expected_result: Support the evidence-artifact concern if either material's available T changes by at least 50% or the boundary category changes under M1 or M2.
prediction_tests.falsifying_result: Reject this bounded concern only if every available per-material T change is <=10%, all required T and G intervals are finite, and the boundary category is unchanged; intermediate or missing outcomes are inconclusive.
prediction_tests.observable: Relative changes in each material's resolved low-concentration support length and any change in the surface-boundary category from M0 to M1 and M2.

required_observables: For all eight executions: case key, material, D, Cs, temperature, time, L, primary or tightened numerical controls, termination state, and raw one-dimensional C(x,480 s).
For every existing selected reference row: exact source fields, dependence_group, mask membership, weight, predicted log concentration, residual, u_y, u_x, u_num, and combined u; no inserted rows.
WRMSE_m,a,k, J_own,k, J_low,k, J_high,k, G_k, grouped uncertainty contributions, and untruncated 95% intervals for M0-M2.
Resolved low-concentration support lengths T_Al,k and T_Ga,k, their per-mask row and adjacency ledgers, propagated intervals, and relative changes from M0.
A pre-execution availability report reproducing headers, categorical domains, total rows, direct-above-limit rows, mask counts, shared-group ownership, and the two documented threshold-crossing gaps.

resource_estimate.runtime_basis: Exactly four one-dimensional primary cells and four paired tightened reruns; all three masks and all statistics reuse these outputs. SProcess R-2020.09 is declared, and the release-matched Skill documents a custom conservative state, explicit fixed boundary equations, diffusion steps, independent cases, and raw PLX/TDR output. The execution context itself provides no capability statements or limitations, so feasibility remains conditional on fresh exact-source domain review and initialization. The prior differently keyed initialized project is context only and supplies no qualification for this intent.

stop_conditions: Stop before implementation if the exact reference availability audit fails any header, categorical value, count, dependence-group, or uncertainty requirement; never restore the unavailable threshold-crossing endpoint or guess a field mapping.

Stop before execution if independent review cannot confirm the frozen custom-state PDE, boundary conditions, independent case reset, units, and raw output in the declared SProcess R-2020.09 backend, or if fresh initialization for this experiment fails.

Stop as numerically inconclusive if any execution fails, any M0 sampled prediction is nonpositive or nonfinite, the maximum paired change exceeds 0.05 decade, or a scientific category changes under tightened numerics.
If either own-anchor M0 WRMSE exceeds 0.15 decade, report the constant-D base family inadequate and surface-boundary control inconclusive; do not reject the hypothesis from model inadequacy.
Support bounded surface-boundary control only when lower95(G_0)>=0.50; reject only when upper95(G_0)<=0.25; otherwise report inconclusive after all prerequisite gates pass.

Support the bounded tail-support artifact concern when any available M1 or M2 per-material T change is >=50% or the boundary category changes; reject only when every required change is <=10% with finite stable intervals; otherwise report inconclusive.
Do not bridge any missing point index, count shared pixels independently, use the all-zero below-limit flags to override central y_value, or treat M2 as qualified primary evidence.
Do not add free parameters, optimize anchors, add a diffusion channel, infer a time-dependent surface source, or proceed to the deferred continuous/two-regime comparison within this experiment.

Stop after one bounded supported, rejected, or inconclusive disposition for each selected hypothesis and one explicit assessment of remaining overall-objective coverage; do not select a microscopic mechanism.

value_assessment.rationale: This round covers both original mandatory observables: M0 whole-profile errors use the two material-resolved profiles, while T and its mask sensitivity quantify the observed low-concentration front/tail contrast only over contiguous existing rows. The unavailable threshold-crossing F, tail extent from F, qualified dose, Delta, and R are deferred rather than treated as current prerequisites; this change is required because both crossings lie across missing point indices. Microscopic continuous-versus-two-regime discrimination also remains deferred until the constant-boundary family is rejected or ambiguous, passes adequacy, and the direct-pixel above-limit low-concentration contrast is stable. These omissions do not invalidate the current supported-row loss or mask-sensitivity calculations because neither bridges a gap and both bind exact table fields, but they restrict claims to the frozen constant-D boundary counterfactual and digitized-evidence robustness. The design is minimal within that claim: four physical cells and four paired convergence controls, three deterministic masks, no fitted parameter, no random inference, and no additional solve for sensitivity reductions. The prior review lowers information gain from high to medium because an inadequate base family or mask-sensitive evidence can still force an inconclusive result. Later microscopic work requires a separately reviewed finite model family; stronger empirical claims require qualified raw SIMS data.

variables.rationale: The full two-material comparison is required; material-specific D remains paired and limits causal interpretation to the declared phenomenological family.
The two exact Table I anchors form the smallest finite boundary intervention and introduce no fitted source history.
These are fixed paper-reported material anchors and are not calibrated or interpreted as a complete physical parameter family.
All supplied profile evidence is restricted to 480 degrees C.
All supplied profile evidence is restricted to the 8 minute treatment.
The domain implementation may choose exact primary mesh and time-step values; the scientific convergence intervention and acceptance threshold are fixed here.

review_request.instruction: 独立审查新物化计划的科学可实施性、最小范围及对总体目标的匹配。请实际核对绑定的逐行参考表；它们是论文数字化观测，不是新 TCAD 结果。重点判断新端点及其不确定度、掩码和判断规则是否能从真实字段与支持计算，是否消除了前轮已证实的数据不可用阻断，以及当前模型对照是否提供有效信息；不要仅核对字段存在。区分足以阻断本轮的实质问题与非阻断改进，不要求本轮覆盖全部总体目标。检查后续目标及其条件被保留，工程设置与科学定义职责明确，历史材料未被当作当前资格。只提交独立正式审查，不改写计划。
